title: Anaesthesia for unusual presentation of rhinosporidiosis: a case report
abstract:
We report a case of right bronchial rhinosporidiosis which was excised using laser/ electric cautery successfully under general anaesthesia using one lung ventilation without any complications and no recurrence on two years follow up.

Key words: Bronchial rhinosporidiosis: Excision, laser, cautery, one lung ventilation

DOI: 10.4038/slja.v18i1.1560

Sri Lankan Journal of Anaesthesiology 18(1): 39-42 (2010)
